title: AI Chatbot for Citizen Helpline Services

demo_extraction.scope_summary: Deliver an Urdu and English AI chatbot for the citizen helpline on web and WhatsApp. Integrate the chatbot with the existing complaint database through REST APIs. Provide an administrator dashboard, staff training and six months of support.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: The firm must hold valid registration with the Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB).
